titre: All Randy's wish list car locations in GTA 6
chapo: Here's where to find every car location needed to complete Randy's wish list in GTA 6
extrait: Completing Randy's wish list in Grand Theft Auto 6 is challenging; you'll have to find rare luxury cars around Leonida, steal them, drive all the way back to Randy's with the police on your heels, and (ideally) do it all without damaging the car. With a total of 19 cars on Randy's list, this is one of the most daunting side missions. Here's where to find all of Randy's wish list cars in GTA 6, whether they're found in a fixed spot or randomly. "Randy's wish list" is an optional exploration mission in GTA 6. It's unlocked in Chapter 3, not long after you've completed the "Crosstown Traffic" main mission. Randy will equip you with a key cloner and ask you to steal a Zorrusso luxury car for him, which is parked in Vice Beach. Once you've brought him the Zorrusso, he'll introduce you to his wish list, which currently contains 16 cars. As you progress through the wish list, Randy will add three more cars, bringing the total to 19 cars. Randy's car wish list is a bit complex because there are several ways to obtain the cars. Here's how it works: Here's an overview of every car on Randy's wish list and how to get it. Beware that the car's color is usually different from Randy's reference picture. Before you start the search, there are a few important things to keep in mind; Randy will adjust your reward based on the state of the car. If it's heavily damaged, you'll get less money! If you return the car in good condition, you'll get the full reward and some bonus money. If your car is damaged, take it to the gas station northwest of Randy's shop and repair it. Then, you can take it to Randy to guarantee yourself some bonus money. Finally, beware of advanced trackers; most cars on Randy's wish list have them, which means the police will learn your location if you drive too slowly. If you bring your partner, there's an advanced tracker workaround you can use, so the tracker won't go off. Let's start with the cars tied to a fixed pickup spot. Unlike the other entries on Randy's wish list, you can't just grab any Coquette D10 or Declasse Mamba GT; you must collect the car at the location given to you by Randy. The same is probably true for the Truffade Thrax, though it's difficult to test, given that this car is extremely rare. The outlier here is the Ocelot Jugular, which isn't part of a mini-mission given by Randy, but since it takes ages to find it in the wild, you'd best use the fixed spawn location below.
